test_Hour_offset_arithmetic: test the Hour offset adding and subtracting hours from datetime objects
test_Minute_offset_arithmetic: test the Minute offset adding and subtracting minutes from datetime objects
test_Second_offset_arithmetic: test the Second offset adding and subtracting seconds from datetime objects
test_Milli_offset_arithmetic: test the Milli offset adding and subtracting milliseconds from datetime objects
test_Micro_offset_arithmetic: test the Micro offset adding and subtracting microseconds from datetime objects
test_Nano_offset_arithmetic: test the Nano offset adding and subtracting nanoseconds from datetime and Timestamp objects
test_tick_add_sub_operations: test tick addition and subtraction combining two tick instances of the same class
test_tick_division_operations: test tick division by another tick instance, integer, float, or timedelta
test_tick_equality_comparison: test tick equality and inequality comparison between tick instances with different multipliers
test_delta_to_tick_conversion: test converting a timedelta or Timedelta object to the appropriate tick subclass
test_tick_addition_with_timedelta: test adding a tick offset with Timedelta, pytimedelta, or timedelta64 objects
test_tick_comparison_with_strs: test that tick offsets raise TypeError when compared with string values
test_tick_comparison_with_timedeltalike: test that tick offsets compare equal to their corresponding timedelta representations
